parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, BATCH-1-741 (batch delivery) remained approved; REPLAY-1-632 was tested as a recovery procedure, but no delivery-mode change was approved at that meeting.

citations.quote: They chose BATCH-1-741 for batch delivery.
The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates. No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
